acceptance: A new site of a body with two baseline sites fails the gate
Two lanes that each remove one key merge clean
A lane diff of the baseline file fails the gate
fix: Hold one key per baseline site (body hash and site) in go/.test-dup-baseline. Treat it as an authority input. Only the boundary prune writes it. Register the change in go/internal/gateregistry/seed_testdup.go.
summary: go/.test-dup-baseline holds only count=330 and a date (checked 2026-11-21). Every lane that removes or adds a duplicate edits the same count line. Two lanes then conflict at landing. The gate also cannot say which site is new.
title: Gate contract G6: testdup baseline holds keys, so two lanes merge clean
